cc_virtual_coms.camera.title: Camera Transmitter
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.hint: Right-click with an empty hand to configure
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.page.vide:
Resolution, frame rate,
colour and night vision.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.page.trig:
Trigger source, hold state,
redstone threshold and the
Create wireless frequency slots.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.page.came:
Per-axis world / sub-level
mode and the local offset.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.page.rend:
Shader preference and the
live stream status.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.resolutio:
Click to cycle presets.
Custom (*) lets you type an
exact size; right click goes back.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.custom_si:
Custom size: 64-1920 wide,
64-1440 high, even numbers.
The frame scheduler may lower
the effective frame rate to
fit the pixel budget.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.fps:
Frames per second. Higher fps
lowers the maximum resolution
the server allows.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.color:
Colour or monochrome output.
Mono + night vision is
thermal-like.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.trigger_s:
OFF: the hold state decides.
ON: circuit/redstone take over
(see the priority table).
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.hold:
Manual hold state. Used when
no circuit or redstone trigger
is active.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.redstone_:
HOLD: stream follows the
signal versus the threshold.
TOGGLE: each rising edge
across the threshold flips it.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.threshold:
0-15. Stream is on above
this value (HOLD) and flips
at this value (TOGGLE).
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.frequency:
Ghost slot: left click copies
the carried/held item, right
click clears. A+B form the
Create wireless frequency pair.

Ghost slot: left click copies
the carried/held item, right
click clears. A+B form the
Create wireless frequency pair.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.axis_mode:
World: absolute world angle.
Sub-level: angle follows the
sub-level rotation.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.euler:
Euler angle written by the
Synaxis circuit: yaw, pitch,
roll in degrees.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.offset:
Camera offset from the block
centre in sub-level space,
-16..16 blocks.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.render_mo:
Follow: use the player's
shader setting.
Off: never use shaders.
On: always try shaders.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.device_na:
Virtual camera device name
assigned by the server.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.fallback_:
Local MJPEG fallback URL.
Read only; never opened
automatically.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.enable_in:
Value of the Synaxis
enable terminal.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.revision:
Config revision; increases on
every accepted change.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.device_sl:
Virtual camera device slot,
or - when none is assigned.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.detail:
Last diagnostic message
from the server.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.done:
Close the screen. All changes
are already sent to the server.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.priority:
Trigger priority (3.4):
1. Synaxis enable terminal
2. Redstone input:
   vanilla neighbours, or
   Create wireless link when
   frequency A and B are set
3. GUI hold state

Source OFF: hold state wins.
Source ON:
  enable=true -> ON (RS ignored)
  enable=false, signal>thr
    -> ON in HOLD mode
  enable=false, signal<=thr
    -> OFF in HOLD mode
  TOGGLE: rising edge flips
Threshold compares 0-15 signal.
cc_virtual_coms.camera.tooltip.fov: Camera vertical field of view in degrees (30-120). Independent of the player FOV.
